title: The Pale Winter
author: Paloma Coldharbour
blurb: Theo Brightwater, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
